title: Skill checks with no in-fiction cost for retrying (e.g. old Maud's 'read the signs yourself' and 'offer to help, in trade' at Maud's Smoke-Hut) can be attempted again immediately after a failure with the exact same odds and no new information — nothing changes between a fail and the next identical attempt, which undercuts the tension of the roll.
